title: John Prats and Isabel Oli mourn the loss of their fur baby Uber: 'There are no words big enough for this kind of pain'
summary: John Prats and Isabel Oli mourned the passing of their beloved dog Uber, who had been part of their family for more than a decade and witnessed their journey from dating to raising their children.
